raw.title: v0.1.1
raw.body:
## Bug Fixes

- **NOT operator precedence** — `!true || true` now correctly evaluates to `true` (NOT binds tighter than OR/AND)
- **Bracket key access** — `$response.body['key-with-special-chars']` now resolves correctly
- **Escaped quotes** — string comparisons with `\"` inside quoted values no longer break the parser
- **Array query parameters** — arrays are now serialized as exploded form (`?ids=a&ids=b`) instead of JSON
- **Cookie encoding** — special characters in cookie values are percent-encoded to prevent header corruption
- **Goto interpolation** — dynamic goto targets like `{$inputs.target}` are now expression-resolved
- **Complex parameter values** — YAML mappings and sequences in parameters are serialized to JSON instead of YAML

## Spec Compliance

- **`!` NOT operator** in simple conditions
- **`()` parenthesis grouping** in compound conditions
- **`Retry-After` response header** overrides configured retry delay per spec §4.6.6
- **`$workflows.<id>.inputs/outputs`** expression root for cross-workflow data access

## Dependencies

- Migrated from `serde_yml` (unmaintained) to `serde_yaml_ng` — clears RUSTSEC-2025-0068

## Stats

- 363 tests passing (up from 339 in v0.1.0)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/strefethen/arazzo-cli/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
